description: This file defines the class ResetConnectionMetricsResponse, a JSON-serializable response object for the ResetConnectionMetrics command within the connectivity modifications of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating and parsing instances, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and provides access to the associated ConnectionId.
